page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2.3xlarge is a general-purpose instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at a base clock speed of 2.5 GHz. Built on an x86_64 architecture with KVM hypervisor management, it provides 16 vCPUs across 8 physical cores with 2.0 threads per core, 64 GB of total system RAM, and no integrated local disk storage. The CPU instruction set features hardware support for AVX, AVX-512, AVX-512 VNNI, AES, BMI2, ADX, and FMA. Network connectivity is configured with a baseline bandwidth of 3 Gbps, and the server includes no discrete GPU hardware.

Performance benchmark results indicate a contrast between single-threaded throughput and parallel multi-core efficiency. Single-core metrics fall into lower performance tiers, recorded at 1001.0 in Geekbench single-core and 19.04 GB/sec in single-threaded gzip compression. Conversely, multi-threaded metrics perform within average ranges, achieving a Geekbench multi-core score of 6324.0, a stress-ng multi-core result of 11798.08, and 56.62 GB/sec in bzip3 decompression. Large uncached memory reads reach 75.86 GB/sec, supporting throughput of 9.98 GB/sec in static web serving and 11.35 million Redis SET operations per second.

The 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM memory balance offers standard resource density for general workloads, though the lack of built-in local SSD storage necessitates attached block storage volumes for persistent data. Given its weak single-core execution speed relative to its average multi-thread capabilities, the instance offers optimal resource efficiency for parallelized server applications, software compilation, containerized microservices, and general database tasks.
